categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Fuzzing' label and adds a new fuzz harness in 'src/test/fuzz/musig.cpp', which falls squarely under fuzzing harnesses.
categories.rationale: Adds dedicated fuzz testing for MuSig2 signing and key aggregation APIs that previously lacked unit test and fuzz coverage. As noted in the discussion, the module's signing functions previously had no unit tests, leaving failure paths and malformed inputs underexercised against adversarial inputs.
